import random

# Define a list of magic ability categories
categories = ["Elemental", "Arcane", "Divine", "Nature", "Shadow"]

# Define a list of magic ability ranks
ranks = ["Novice", "Apprentice", "Adept", "Master", "Legend"]

# Define a list of magic ability limitations
limitations = ["Physical toll", "Magical exhaustion", "Unstable energy", "Dependence on specific materials", "Vulnerability to specific elements"]

# Define a list of magic ability costs
costs = ["Simple spellcasting", "Complex incantations", "Ritualistic practices", "Sacrifices", "Mental focus"]

# Define a list of magic ability descriptions
descriptions = [
    "Unleashes a burst of elemental energy",
    "Manipulates the fabric of reality",
    "Channels divine power",
    "Communes with nature spirits",
    "Deals with the shadows"
]

# Define a list of overpowered magic ability names
overpowered_names = ["The Devourer", "The Unmaker", "The Bringer of Darkness", "The Weaver of Fate", "The Eye of the Beholder"]

# Define a list of overpowered magic ability limitations
overpowered_limitations = ["Unpredictable and uncontrollable", "Requires immense magical energy", "Causes catastrophic consequences", "Destroys the user's soul", "Rewrites reality"]

# Define a list of overpowered magic ability costs
overpowered_costs = ["Unimaginable sacrifice", "Unbearable pain", "Unrelenting mental strain", "Unending physical toll", "Unraveling of the fabric of reality"]

def generate_magic_ability():
    # Randomly select a category
    category = random.choice(categories)

    # Randomly select a rank
    rank = random.choice(ranks)

    # Randomly select a limitation
    limitation = random.choice(limitations)

    # Randomly select a cost
    cost = random.choice(costs)

    # Randomly select a description
    description = random.choice(descriptions)

    # If the rank is Legend, randomly select an overpowered name, limitation, and cost
    if rank == "Legend":
        name = random.choice(overpowered_names)
        limitation = random.choice(overpowered_limitations)
        cost = random.choice(overpowered_costs)
    else:
        name = f"{category} {rank} Magic"
        limitation = f"{category} {rank} Magic Limitation"
        cost = f"{category} {rank} Magic Cost"

    # Return the generated magic ability
    return {
        "name": name,
        "description": description,
        "category": category,
        "rank": rank,
        "limitation": limitation,
        "cost": cost
    }

# Generate 10 magic abilities
for _ in range(10):
    print(generate_magic_ability())
